structure: Single K-12 PDF (366 pp). Front matter (cover, TOC, Introduction) then 12 Anchor Standards (domains Civics & Government CG.P/RL/RR, History H.CC/HP/IG, Geography G.HPE/HSP/WST, Economics E.SA/PC/EG; each with Identify/Explain/Analyze/Argue levels) that apply K-12, then Content Standards overview/how-to-read. Grade sections (Kindergarten, GRADE 1-8; HS courses follow outside this part) each open with a title+narrative unit and a 'Topics of Inquiry, Compelling Questions, and Standards' list (Inquiry Topic N, compelling question, standard codes+short titles), then 'Standards Tables'. Each inquiry topic has a heading unit (topic + compelling question) and one table per standard. Standard codes: SSK.t.s (K), SS1.t.s ... SS8.t.s = Social Studies grade, inquiry topic, standard. Table layout: first-column/second cells hold code + title + one-sentence standard statement (often split across several units by line wrap), 'Connections to the Rhode Island Anchor Standards' header, the 12 anchor-code cells (CG.P ... E.EG) and 'X' marker cells for aligned anchors, then a row with 'Guiding Questions for Instruction' (examples) and 'Learning Assessment Objectives' (a-g indicators unpacking the standard; labeled standards). Grade comes from grade section headings and the SSg code; no course content in this part (courses are HS only). Running headers carry only page numbers.

u68-u93: Anchor Standards overview, the four-verb rigor hierarchy definitions, CRSE design principles and footnotes labeled backup (explanatory); u70-u74 are an extracted diagram of the four domains with fragmentary text ('Rhode Island's Social St' / 'udies Anchor Standards'). u95-u113 anchor standards (4 levels per anchor, one unit per domain/anchor group, merged text) labeled standards with grades K-12 since they apply to all grades.
u115-u131 content-standards overview and 'How to read the standards' / sample table descriptions labeled backup, grades all.

u133, u478, u866, u1204, u1840, u2317, u2782, u3196: grade title + narrative description in one unit; labeled standards because title and narrative are merged (narrative would otherwise be examples). u478 and u866 also merge the Topics-of-Inquiry list (standard codes+titles) into the same unit.

Topic overview lists (u134, u480, u867, u1205, u1207, u1841, u1843, u2318, u2320, u2783, u2785, u3197, u3199) list inquiry topics, compelling questions and standard codes/titles; labeled standards. Inquiry Topic heading units (topic + compelling question merged, e.g. u236, u321, u404) labeled standards (heading); compelling question not separable.

Standard statement text is split across line-wrap fragments (e.g. u137-u161 K SSK.1.1: 'Explain families, family roles, and' / 'family rules through looking at the' ...); all fragments kept in order in the standards label of that table. Anchor-code cells (CG.P..E.EG) and 'X' alignment markers (cells with no text value other than X) labeled standards as part of the standard table. Some codes are truncated or lowercase in extraction (u2461 'E.E' for E.EG in SS5.2.4; u2977-u2978 lowercase 'x' in SS6.3.2).

Table-structure irregularities: in some tables the second standard-statement line or anchor cells fall in rows differently (R4/R5/R6) and the standard statement is placed in C1 together with the code (e.g. u216, u260); no effect on labeling. 'white supremacy's role in the rise o').
